dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two prominent, thick light-gray/white horizontal bands are visible across the greater and median coverts with high contrast against the darker gray secondary coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Highly prominent, sharp pale edges on the tertials and folded secondaries create a distinct tiered linear boundary against the darker feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A dark, semi-circular cap terminates at the posterior crown, contrasted by a broad white expanse across the nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, distinct linear color transition boundary is visible between the black/dark-gray crown and the white upper mantle/nape area.
